tagging: Every test that verifies a criterion names it in its title, e.g. 'SHOP-142 AC-1 ...'

acs.text: User can enter a discount code in the cart

checks.description: Cart page has a labelled 'Discount code' input and an Apply button; a typed code is kept in the input

acs.text: Valid codes apply the discount to the total
acs.clarified_as: Valid codes are SAVE10 (10% off) and FLAT20 ($20 off, only when subtotal >= $50, otherwise refused with 'This code needs a subtotal of at least $50.'). On the $120 cart: SAVE10 -> $108.00, FLAT20 -> $100.00. One code at a time: a second code replaces the first. Showing the discount line and new total in the cart is enough; reload/checkout out of scope. Expiry not checked for this story; letter case is accepted risk and not tested. (Q-1, Q-6, Q-AI-1, Q-AI-2, Q-AI-3, Q-AI-4, Q-AI-6)

checks.description: POST /api/cart/discount with SAVE10 returns discount 12 and total 108; with FLAT20 returns discount 20 and total 100
FLAT20 below a $50 subtotal is refused with 'This code needs a subtotal of at least $50.'; at exactly $50 it applies (discount rules called directly, since the demo cart is fixed at $120)
In the browser, applying SAVE10 shows 'Discount (SAVE10) −$12.00' and Total $108.00; then applying FLAT20 replaces it with −$20.00 and Total $100.00

acs.clarified_as: Empty code shows exactly 'Enter a discount code.'; unknown code shows exactly 'That code is not valid.'; the total stays $120.00. A bad code entered after SAVE10 removes the SAVE10 discount. (Q-2, Q-AI-5)

checks.description: API returns 400 with the exact error text for an empty code and an unknown code
In the browser, empty and unknown codes show the exact error in an alert and Total stays $120.00
After SAVE10 is applied, an unknown code shows the error, removes the discount line and Total returns to $120.00

acs.reason: Product owner recorded accepted risk at Gate 1 (Q-3): no speed threshold was set, so there is no pass/fail line to test against.

acs.clarified_as: On a Pixel 7 (Chrome) a shopper can enter a code, apply it, see the new total and see errors, with no sideways scrolling. (Q-4, Q-5)

checks.description: Playwright 'mobile' project (Pixel 7): apply SAVE10 -> Total $108.00, page has no horizontal overflow
Playwright 'mobile' project (Pixel 7): unknown code shows 'That code is not valid.', no horizontal overflow
